---
title: "Labels"
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
    comment: "#>"
---

`og_text()` writes a column's values on the map: names, ids, numbers. Each of its looks takes a value, or a column
written bare, so every row may have its own. Where two labels meet, MapLibre draws the first placed and leaves out the
other; zoom in and they part.

```{r}
library(ogis)
```

## At points, in areas and along lines

The Danish harbours are areas; their ids are written inside them. `view` opens the map on Denmark, an extent of west,
south, east and north (the harbours reach far beyond it).

```{r}
#| out-height: 400px
harbours <- og_example("dansk_harbours")
og_map(view = list(bounds = c(8, 54.5, 13, 58))) |>
  og_polygon(harbours, fill = "#d9822b", name = "Harbours") |>
  og_text(harbours, label = SI_HARB, fontface = "italic",
          name = "Harbour ids")
```

The survey's tows are lines; their ids are written along them, at their middle, where a tow is long enough to hold
its id.

```{r}
#| out-height: 400px
tows <- og_example("trawlsurveytows")
og_map(view = list(bounds = c(-24.5, 65.2, -21.5, 66.6))) |>
  og_line(tows, name = "Tows") |>
  og_text(tows, label = id.lgs, size = 11, offset = c(0, 0.8),
          name = "Tow ids")
```

`offset = c(x, y)` moves a label, in text heights: here a little up, so it sits on its line rather than across it.
`fontface` is `"plain"`, `"italic"`, `"bold"` or `"bold.italic"`, as ggplot2's.

## A label's own angle, zoom and priority

Columns made in the pipe, with dplyr, before the map. The survey's positions are written as their vessel's number,
turned to the vessel's heading (`angle` is counter-clockwise, as ggplot2's; a heading is clockwise from north). The
positions on a tow show from zoom 4, the others from zoom 9 (zoom in to see them), and where two meet, the faster is
placed first.

```{r}
positions <- og_example("trawlsurvey") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    turn = 90 - heading,
    from = dplyr::if_else(behaviour == "hauling", 4, 9)
  )
og_map() |>
  og_text(positions, label = vid, angle = turn, minzoom = from,
          priority = speed, colour = behaviour, legend = TRUE,
          name = "Positions")
```

`minzoom` as a column shows each row from its own zoom, from the first whole zoom at or above it: a label due at 7.4
shows from 8, since MapLibre judges a zoom in a filter at whole zooms. A turned label keeps the upright box round it
clear of others, so turned labels leave more room around them than level ones. `overlap = TRUE` draws every label,
words over words where they meet.

## A band of zooms

`endzoom` is where a label stops: from the first whole zoom at or above it, as a number or a column, each row its
own. With `minzoom`, a label shows in a band of zooms, so two layers can take turns. Here each position is written as
its vessel's number until zoom 10, and from 10, as its speed in knots:

```{r}
og_map(view = list(center = c(-18.8, 67), zoom = 9.5)) |>
  og_point(positions, colour = behaviour, name = "Positions") |>
  og_text(positions, label = vid, endzoom = 10, offset = c(0, 1),
          name = "Vessel") |>
  og_text(dplyr::mutate(positions, knots = round(speed, 1)), label = knots,
          minzoom = 10, offset = c(0, 1), name = "Speed")
```

Zoom in past 10 and the numbers change. A row with no end shows on, and a search (`search`) takes the map to a zoom
where its label shows, before its end.
